_doc: Template – see README.md › Config. Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
name: product-demo
_theme: Overlay shape and motion (README.md › Themes): a preset – frame, calm, spotlight, energetic, minimal – or an object { "preset": "calm", "highlight": { "pad": 6 }, … } with sections highlight, cursor, ripple, camera, modal, typing. Choose it per video; run pnpm voice-meta after changing it.
_hover: Optional CSS selector of hoverable elements (default: .hoverable, [data-hover], button, [role=button], .btn, .tab, .opt, .btn-close)
_audioPattern: "auto" = file whose name starts with the scene id (1_Chapter_1.mp3, 01-intro.mp3). Or a pattern: {n} id, {nn} 2-digit id, {slug}, {i}/{ii} position among voiced scenes – e.g. "{n}_Chapter_1.mp3".
